name: Selected locale persists across in-app navigation
description: Once a non-default locale is selected, navigating to another page within the app must keep that locale (the new page renders in the selected language, via the URL prefix or stored preference). A skeleton that resets to English on every navigation fails this test.

planSteps.description: Click a bracket match cell or a nav link to move to another page within the app

Verify the destination page is still rendered in Spanish: its URL stays under the /es prefix and its UI chrome (nav labels, tab names) is in Spanish rather than reverting to English. If navigation drops the user back into English, the test fails.
